name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Account Executive - Digital Marketing & Reputation Management Services
summary: Full-cycle Account Executive with direct experience selling SEO, digital marketing, and reputation/local-listings-management services, not SaaS, to SMB and enterprise buyers. Closed $130K+ in agency bookings at Fetch & Funnel, sold Birdeye's proprietary reputation-management and local-listings platform to 15-20 channel partners at roughly 94% retention, and now runs full-cycle sales for Solenzo's own SEO and marketing-automation service line. Comfortable presenting digital strategy to C-suite executives and negotiating retainer-based, SOW-driven contracts.

Claim, set up, and optimize Google Business Profile listings as the first deliverable in every client engagement, the foundation the rest of each client's local SEO and lead-flow program builds on.
Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword gap analyses, and competitor research using Screaming Frog, translating findings into a scoped proposal and closing the engagement.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand retainer scope, consultatively recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with each client's objectives.
Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of B2B service clients, running discovery to surface goals and market challenges before proposing a path forward.

Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations through QBRs.
